reason: auth-ui is a vanilla-TS SPA (no React/exported components, no Storybook). The standard converter cannot extract a component bundle, so this is a hand-built token-only sync. Do NOT run package-build.mjs against this repo.
notes: Re-sync: rebuild auth-ui (pnpm --filter @sada/auth-ui build), copy the fresh dist CSS over _ds_bundle.css, refresh token values from src/style.css if changed, re-upload. Fonts are remote Google Fonts (no fonts/ dir). No _ds_sync.json anchor — every re-sync re-uploads the full set.
